title: [v3-4-test] Wait for variable form validation before asserting Save is enabled (#75239)
body:
Rendering the JSON warning does not wait for asynchronous form validity updates, so the submission tests can race the disabled Save button.
(cherry picked from commit 92a9e5aad39ee372797c4676b94949c0eec2bd22)
